brief.brand: EPOMAKER. Public-site research candidate, not a client or approved partnership. Candidate product: Galaxy100 QMK/VIA. Exact SKU, switch and permissions pending.
brief.audience: Proposed hypothesis: keyboard enthusiasts, gaming/internet-culture viewers and desk-setup audiences. Fit is inferred from saved audience research and the brand’s public gaming/coding/desk categories, not verified buyer analytics.
brief.objective: One original five-second vertical concept for review. No generated sample, views, sales or campaign outcome promised.
brief.creative: An original fictional desk clerk treats a single keyboard press like an important inspection. Use original character, set and wording. Hold the exact approved product layout clearly. No game franchise assets or copied creator likeness.
brief.constraints: Draft only. No quote, spend approval, generation, posting or outreach. No approved commercial identity/voice. Candidate product photograph is source research, not an attached or approved generation asset. Confirm exact product/color/switch/SKU and usage permission. Preserve key legends, knob and numpad layout. Do not invent performance, latency, sound-quality, price or endorsement claims. A key sound must be a permitted recording of the exact selected switch/setup, not generated audio represented as authentic. If no approved sound exists, keep the concept audio unresolved. No branded sample is attached. Three edit beats are not asserted provider-supported clip lengths.

consistency: Use the same approved face reference across shots.
Lock wardrobe, proportions, hair, and distinguishing features.
Keep the voice ID and reference performance stable.
